contract: Two members join one generation. The leader's assignment gives each partition to one member. A follower cannot publish an assignment.
A session timeout removes the silent member, bumps the generation, and clears assignments. The old generation cannot sync.
An unknown member id is rejected. A stale coordinator epoch cannot sync.
Reopen restores the coordinator epoch and the disjoint assignment.
limits: This is not the JoinGroup or SyncGroup RPC.
Heartbeats, leave, and static or cooperative revocation stay on KL11-28.
The journal format is the local PLGRP001 snapshot, not an Apache group metadata record.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
